newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices remain steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds -Prices remain steady to lower.

text.p: Millfeed prices continued to be steady to lower on Friday, capping a holiday week of subdued activity, dealers said.
"It is still tight for next week," a St Louis dealer said, referring to nearby millfeed supply. But he noted that sales activity was generally dull.
Another dealer said the milder temperatures this week in parts of the Midwest dampened demand.
In the Kansas/Oklahoma area, a dealer said the holiday week may have caused some logistical problems.
